name: Grub
summary: At a hut east of the Crossroads, Grub runs a roadside eatery with a cook and a baker. He is known for teaching travelers to cook with the Barrens' local vermin.

sections.title: A Frontier Appetite
sections.body: East of the Crossroads, Grub shares a hut with Duhng, his cook, and Tarban Hearthgrain, a baker. Grub makes use of the Barrens' dig rats instead of letting them go to waste. He offers travelers a recipe for simmering the rodents into stew.

faq.answer: Grub is an orc who lives in a hut east of the Crossroads in the Barrens. He runs a small eatery with Duhng, his cook, and Tarban Hearthgrain, a baker, for travelers passing through.
Find Grub in a small hut at the foot of the mountains, just east of the Crossroads in the Barrens, off the main path.

faq.q: What does Grub need help with?
faq.answer: Grub needs travelers to gather dig rats from the Barrens for his Dig Rat Stew. He shares the recipe with cooks who prepare it.

angles.text: As a cook, you can learn Grub's Dig Rat Stew recipe by gathering its ingredients.
As Horde, you can find Grub's roadside kitchen just outside the Crossroads, where he offers travelers food and a lesson in making use of what the plains provide.
